name: Cozy Corner
author: Bad Ideas Works
description: Warm drinks, small stakes and a goose who has made this personal.

forms.in: during the first snowfall of the year
over one long, lazy summer holiday
in an autumn that lasts forever
one sleepy Sunday at a time

forms.noun: cat café on a rainy street
forms.in: in a little cat café on a rainy street
in a town built among the treetops

forms.noun: tiny island with one shop and one ferry
forms.in: on a tiny island with one shop and one ferry
aboard a floating teahouse on a lazy river
inside a bookshop that never quite closes
in a village of chatty mushrooms

forms.noun: retired adventurer who just wants to bake
dragon too small to be scary
grandmother with a suspiciously exciting past
frog who runs a tea stall

forms.verb: make the whole village feel at home
restore the old community garden
throw the best autumn festival the valley has ever seen
befriend every animal on the island
keep the café open through the long winter
find the perfect spot for every houseplant
win the annual giant vegetable contest
water the plants, chat with the neighbours and nap in the sun
bake in the morning, deliver in the afternoon and knit by the fire
forage, brew tea and decorate
tidy one room at a time and rediscover forgotten treasures
fish, garden and gossip
serve regulars, learn their orders and remember their birthdays
blend teas for very particular customers
nudge furniture around until it feels just right
fill friendship hearts with thoughtful gifts
plant crops that change with the seasons
knit scarves for anyone who looks a bit chilly
write letters and wait eagerly for replies
wash dishes in perfect, soapy rhythm

forms.clause: the neighbour's cat keeps judging your garden
the village council has strong opinions about your fence

forms.noun: the empty houses down the lane
forms.clause: half the houses down the lane are still empty
a rival baker's sourdough is the talk of the town
winter is arriving a week early this year
a goose has declared you its sworn enemy

forms.noun: hand-painted gouache with steam rising from every cup

forms.clause: every resident is secretly a retired villain
the whole village sits on the back of a very large, very sleepy turtle
you are the ghost haunting the café, and everyone is fine with it
the cat who judges your garden is actually the mayor
the seasons only change when someone receives a heartfelt gift
the whole town is a snow globe on someone's mantelpiece
nobody ever leaves the island, simply because nobody wants to

forms.pitch: A nap system: doze off in sunny spots for tiny, cumulative bonuses.
forms.connects: Well-rested players {loop.verb} a little faster, which feels like cheating but isn't.

forms.pitch: Every resident {setting.in} gets a birthday, a favourite gift and a firm opinion about jam.
forms.connects: Remembering birthdays turns {resource.noun} into friendships, and friendships into help.

forms.pitch: Exchange letters with a lighthouse keeper on a faraway island.
forms.connects: Every reply arrives with seeds, a recipe or a small parcel of {resource.noun}.

forms.pitch: Open a little café that turns your harvest into pastries.
forms.connects: Café profits fund every step toward your goal to {objective.verb}.

forms.pitch: A scrapbook that fills itself with photos of everyone you've helped.
Seasonal festivals with stalls, lanterns and a contest for the largest marrow.
forms.connects: Festival prizes reward a whole year of hard work, and the winner is never allowed to forget it.

forms.pitch: A decorating mode for every room, shed and birdhouse {setting.in}.
A Sunday bake-off judged, without exception, by {threat.noun}.
Let players adopt the cat. Then another one. There is no cat limit.
A weather radio that only plays gentle forecasts and lo-fi music.

hook.text: [a] {mood.adj} {genre.adj} {subgenre.noun} where [a] {protagonist.noun} tries to {objective.verb} {setting.in}, one cup of tea at a time.

pitchThreat.text: The only real danger: {threat.clause}. Everything else can wait until after your nap.

mightWork.text: But [a] {setting.noun} is the kind of place people want to live in, and {mechanic.noun} is soothing enough to play for hours.

scopeNote.text: Start with {mechanic.noun} and one tiny {setting.noun}. Add more cats later. There will always be more cats.
